safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold includes aerosinusitis history; it is not present in generated PMH (only mentioned indirectly via antihistamine use, without naming the condition).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting a history of aerosinusitis is unlikely to alter management of this acute suspected allergic/anaphylactic reaction and does not meaningfully change immediate risk stratification. The main clinically relevant history here is the sting exposure, respiratory symptoms, eczema, and penicillin allergy.
